_about: Rules used by `tv.py audit`. action: remove | disable | ask-remove | ask | launcher-swap | keep. 'verified' lists the TVs a rule was confirmed on; unverified rules are suggestions only and the audit + owner decide. First matching rule wins; a trailing * is a prefix match.

packages.label: Play Auto Installs
packages.why: Silently re-installs partner apps after you remove them

packages.label: Google feedback reporter
packages.why: Crash/feedback telemetry; not needed on a TV

packages.label: Calendar sync
packages.why: Calendar sync has no use on a TV

packages.label: Print service
